entities.name: Dezső László
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Colonel General  Vitéz Dezső László was a captain during World War I and general during World War II. After the war, he was first sentenced to 15 years in prison by the National Council of People's Courts on charges of war crimes. Later, following a retrial, he was sentenced to death and executed by the People's Republic of Hungary in 1949.
